# qdrant-cloud_serverless_space_api_key (Resource)

Serverless Space API Key Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
// Setup Terraform, including the qdrant-cloud providers
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.7.0"
  required_providers {
    qdrant-cloud = {
      source  = "qdrant/qdrant-cloud"
      version = ">=1.30.0"
    }
  }
}

// Add the provider to specify some provider wide settings
provider "qdrant-cloud" {
  api_key    = "" // API Key generated in Qdrant Cloud (required)
  account_id = "" // The default account ID you want to use in Qdrant Cloud (can be overriden on resource level)
}

// Pick the first available serverless cloud region
data "qdrant-cloud_serverless_cloud_regions" "all" {}
locals {
  cloud_region_id = [for r in data.qdrant-cloud_serverless_cloud_regions.all.regions : r.id if r.available][0]
}

// Create a serverless space
resource "qdrant-cloud_serverless_space" "example" {
  name            = "example-space"
  cloud_region_id = local.cloud_region_id
}

// Create an API key with read-only access to the entire space
resource "qdrant-cloud_serverless_space_api_key" "read_only" {
  space_id = qdrant-cloud_serverless_space.example.id
  name     = "read-only-key"
  global_access_rule {
    access_type = "GLOBAL_ACCESS_RULE_ACCESS_TYPE_READ_ONLY"
  }
}

// Create an API key with write access to a single collection, expiring at the end of the year
resource "qdrant-cloud_serverless_space_api_key" "collection_writer" {
  space_id   = qdrant-cloud_serverless_space.example.id
  name       = "collection-writer-key"
  expires_at = "2026-12-31T23:59:59Z"
  collection_access_rules {
    collection_name = "my-collection"
    access_type     = "COLLECTION_ACCESS_RULE_ACCESS_TYPE_READ_WRITE"
  }
}

// Output the secret key (only available after creation)
output "read_only_key" {
  value     = qdrant-cloud_serverless_space_api_key.read_only.key
  sensitive = true
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Serverless Space API Key Schema Name of the API key (4-128 characters: letters, numbers, spaces, `_` and `-`) field
- `space_id` (String) Serverless Space API Key Schema ID of the serverless space this API key grants access to field

### Optional

- `account_id` (String) Serverless Space API Key Schema Account ID (defaults to the provider account ID) field
- `collection_access_rules` (Block List, Max: 20) A list of rules granting access to specific collections (max 20). Cannot be used with `global_access_rule`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--collection_access_rules))
- `expires_at` (String) Serverless Space API Key Schema Expiration time (RFC3339) of the API key. If not set, the key does not expire field
- `global_access_rule` (Block List, Max: 1) A rule granting access to the entire space. Cannot be used with `collection_access_rules`. If no rules are provided, global `MANAGE` access is granted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--global_access_rule))
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Serverless Space API Key Schema Creation time field
- `id` (String) Serverless Space API Key Schema API Key ID field
- `key` (String, Sensitive) Serverless Space API Key Schema Secret key, only available after creation (empty after import) field
- `postfix` (String) Serverless Space API Key Schema Last characters of the key, to identify it field
- `state` (List of Object) Serverless Space API Key Schema Current state of the API key field (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--state))

<a id="nestedblock--collection_access_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `collection_access_rules`

Required:

- `access_type` (String) Access type for the collection. Must be one of: COLLECTION_ACCESS_RULE_ACCESS_TYPE_READ_ONLY, COLLECTION_ACCESS_RULE_ACCESS_TYPE_READ_WRITE.
- `collection_name` (String) Name of the collection.


<a id="nestedblock--global_access_rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `global_access_rule`

Required:

- `access_type` (String) Access type for the entire space. Must be one of: GLOBAL_ACCESS_RULE_ACCESS_TYPE_MANAGE, GLOBAL_ACCESS_RULE_ACCESS_TYPE_METRICS_READ_ONLY, GLOBAL_ACCESS_RULE_ACCESS_TYPE_READ_ONLY.


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--state"></a>
### Nested Schema for `state`

Read-Only:

- `phase` (String)
- `reason` (String)




## Import

`qdrant-cloud_serverless_space_api_key` can be imported using a composite ID of `<space_id>/<api_key_id>`, e.g.

```
$ terraform import qdrant-cloud_serverless_space_api_key.example 12345678-0000-0000-0000-1234567890ab/abcdefgh-0000-0000-0000-1234567890ab
```

Note that the secret `key` is only available at creation time, so it is empty after import.
